The first reading asserted that dragging along the band isotopes f_1 to its band sum f_1-prime in the original boundary M. A handle slide need not preserve that attaching-sphere isotopy class in M; the parallel sphere becomes trivial only after the other handle is attached. The disk-and-band isotopy must be constructed in the outgoing boundary after h_2, then applied with the isotopic-attachment lemma. A later targeted read found this passage corrected by another writer. Initially a lower slide c_j-prime=c_j+epsilon c_i was asserted to change the same belt column by addition. In fact the belt/coefficient basis transforms inversely: substituting c_j=c_j-prime-epsilon c_i-prime changes column i by subtracting epsilon times column j in this supplier's upper-row intersection convention. The correct change follows from the inverse target-basis matrix, not from copying the core basis transformation onto belts. A later targeted read found this passage corrected by another writer. Initially B was the graph of sin(2 pi x) in R^2/Z^2, and A cap B was claimed to consist of only x=0,1/2. At x=1/4,3/4 the graph has y=+1,-1, also zero modulo Z, with derivative zero. Thus there are additional tangential intersections and the claimed transverse two-point witness is false. Scaling the amplitude below 1 and fixing the interval parametrizations supplies the intended witness. A later targeted read found this passage corrected by another writer. findings.location: Current Proof 1.1, sentence beginning "Every handle body"
findings.evidence: The current proof says every handle body of this presentation is the same subset of W as in any other presentation. Different presentations can have different handle numbers and embedded bodies: compare a product's empty presentation with one containing a created cancelling pair. Only the chosen presentation and its dual share the selected bodies. Delete or restrict this sentence. The initially read Statement/Proof 3.1 also incorrectly placed the dual connecting handles first; later targeted reading confirms that ordering is now corrected to last.

Run the actual low-index deletion procedure on the reversed low-index-free presentation and prove that its new indices do not reintroduce the excluded original ones. Construct on the outgoing region the actual map (x,y)->[x] in D^k/S^(k-1), whose fibre over [0] is the belt sphere, then compute its local degrees.
